'''Yané''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who served as one of the [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaidens]] of [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Biography==
[[File:YaneTraining-QiD.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Yané, shooting a training droid during her handmaiden training]]
Yané was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] who [[Naboo (people)/Legends|hailed]] [[Homeworld/Legends|from]]<ref name="DB" /> the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">''[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|Star Wars: Complete Locations]]''</ref> [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], where she was chosen as a royal [[Naboo Royal Handmaidens/Legends|handmaiden]] for her homeworld's [[Queen/Legends|queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], after her [[Coronation of Queen Amidala/Legends|coronation]]. In the six [[Standard month/Legends|months]] that followed, Yané would have to able to defend Amidala,<ref name="FF37">{{FactFile|37|HAN 1-4|Amidala's Handmaidens}}</ref> and she eventually became the youngest of<ref name="DB" /> the five handmaidens Amidala had, the four others being [[Rabé/Legends|Rabé]], [[Saché/Legends|Saché]], [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], and [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]].<ref name="EP1VD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Yane was trained in self-defense and marksmanship by Amidala's head of security, [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]].<ref name="QiD" /> She was also a musician.<ref name="CCGCL">{{CCG|set=Coruscant Limited|cardname=Yané}}</ref>

Yané remained behind with Saché during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Trade Federation Crisis]] when the [[Queen/Legends|Queen]], Sabé, Rabé and Eirtaé fled the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with the help of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]].<ref name="TPM" />

Yané was later reunited with Queen Amidala and her fellow handmaidens after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]], and attended both [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn's]] [[Funeral of Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|funeral]] and the Celebration [[Parade/Legends|Parade]].<ref name="TPM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Yané was portrayed by [[Candice Orwell]] in [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="TPM" />

Yané was cut from the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other|directory tree files}}</ref> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Yané and four other Queen Amidala's handmaidens — [[Eirtaé/Legends|Eirtaé]], [[Rabé/Legends|Rabé]], [[Sabé/Legends|Sabé]] and [[Saché/Legends|Saché]] — were intended to be introduced in the game with the [[2005]] "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]." They would have been featured in a quest named "Helping the Handmaidens," included in the Naboo part of the so-called "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the longest questline in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
